A14.3: the calls inside the route lambdas are collected as CallSites of itemRoutes (the `get` / `post` heads are ROUTEs, never calls). CA.6a: `store` is a function PARAMETER typed `ItemStore`; the Kotlin parser records it as a local type of itemRoutes (LA.35a's local_types, marker `[kotlin] local types: scopes=2 typed=1 unknown=1`), which the receiver-type pass reads before property types, so `store.all()` binds ItemStore::all through `import com.acme.store.ItemStore` — CALLS 0/1 -> 1/1, no longer the parameter-typed-receiver residual.
